reason: The round-up reciprocal multiplier m = ceil(2^34/7) = 2454267027 = (2^34+5)/7 gives approximation floor(v/7 + 5v/(7·2^34)); for large v (v > ~3.44e9, i.e. many legal uint32 values) with v mod 7 = 6 the error term exceeds 1/7 and the computed quotient is off by one, so the contract (exact for every uint32 value) is violated.
